display.description: Display name of the real X server to forward to (e.g., ':0' or 'localhost:1'). Empty uses $DISPLAY.

fakedisplay.description: Display name for the faked X server listener (e.g., ':99'). Empty uses $FAKEDISPLAY or ':9'.

authfile.description: Path to xauth file for the real server tokens. Empty uses $XAUTHORITY.

new_authfile.description: Path to xauth file for saving faked server tokens. Empty implies copying tokens.

copy_authentication.description: Copy MIT-MAGIC-COOKIE-1 tokens from real to fake server.

read_write_debug.description: Print byte counts for reads and writes.

interactive.description: Require interactive confirmation for each client request.

outfile.description: Filename to dump trace output into.

buffered.description: Use buffered output for the trace file.

print_offsets.description: Print field offsets in trace output.

print_counts.description: Print list counts in trace output.

max_klist_length.description: Max elements to print from lists. 0 is no limit.

keep_running.description: Keep faked server running after clients disconnect.

wait_for_client.description: Wait for a client if the launched command exits immediately.

command.description: Command to execute with the faked display. Empty for daemon mode.
